# apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_sets (Data Source)

Lists the account's Game Center matchmaking rule sets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_matchmaking_rule_sets" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `rule_sets` (Attributes List) The rule sets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_sets))

<a id="nestedatt--rule_sets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rule_sets`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the rule set.
- `max_players` (Number) Most players in a match.
- `min_players` (Number) Fewest players in a match.
- `reference_name` (String) Name of the rule set.
- `rule_language_version` (Number) Version of the rule expression language.
